comment:
* Allows tasks with associated priorities to control how they proceed relative to one another. * *

A task should call {@link #add(int)} to register with the manager and {@link #remove(int)} to * unregister. A registered task will prevent tasks of lower priority from proceeding, and should * call {@link #proceed(int)}, {@link #proceedNonBlocking(int)} or {@link #proceedOrThrow(int)} each * time it wishes to check whether it is itself allowed to proceed.

methods.name: public void add(int priority)
methods.comment:
* Register a new task. The task must call {@link #remove(int)} when done.
   *
   * @param priority The priority of the task. Larger values indicate higher priorities.

methods.name: public void proceed(int priority) throws InterruptedException
methods.comment:
* Blocks until the task is allowed to proceed.
   *
   * @param priority The priority of the task.
   * @throws InterruptedException If the thread is interrupted.

methods.name: public boolean proceedNonBlocking(int priority)
methods.comment:
* A non-blocking variant of {@link #proceed(int)}.
   *
   * @param priority The priority of the task.
   * @return Whether the task is allowed to proceed.

methods.name: public void proceedOrThrow(int priority) throws PriorityTooLowException
methods.comment:
* A throwing variant of {@link #proceed(int)}.
   *
   * @param priority The priority of the task.
   * @throws PriorityTooLowException If the task is not allowed to proceed.

methods.name: public void remove(int priority)
methods.comment:
* Unregister a task.
   *
   * @param priority The priority of the task.

methodNames: public void proceed(int priority) throws InterruptedException
public void proceedOrThrow(int priority) throws PriorityTooLowException
